declaration.preface:
At Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. we prioritize the well-being and dignity of our employees. Grounded in the principles of social responsibility and economic justice, this policy represents our dedication in providing fair and equitable compensation that enables our workforce to meet their fundamental needs. As a leading player in the textile industry, we understand that the success of our business is intricately tied to the prosperity and satisfaction of our employees. By implementing a living wage, we aim not only to enhance the lives of our workers but also to contribute to the broader social and economic fabric of the communities in which we operate.

At Exim Knits Pvt Ltd., we believe that every individual contributing to our success deserves to earn a wage that ensures a decent standard of living. This Living Wage Policy goes beyond mere compliance with legal standards; it reflects our acknowledgment of the dynamic cost of living and our commitment in providing compensation that keeps pace with these fluctuations. By adopting this policy, we seek to establish a foundation for a thriving workforce, where employees are not only valued for their skills and contributions but are also empowered to lead fulfilling lives both inside and outside the workplace.

This Living Wage Policy is a testament to our corporate values and our aspiration to be a socially responsible industry leader. It represents a collaborative effort to address the diverse needs of our workforce while contributing to the broader goals of economic fairness and equality.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
At Exim Knits Pvt Ltd. we prioritize the well-being and dignity of our employees. Grounded in the principles of social responsibility and economic justice, this policy represents our dedication in providing fair and equitable compensation that enables our workforce to meet their fundamental needs.

At Exim Knits Pvt Ltd., we believe that every individual contributing to our success deserves to earn a wage that ensures a decent standard of living. This Living Wage Policy goes beyond mere compliance with legal standards; it reflects our acknowledgment of the dynamic cost of living and our commitment in providing compensation that keeps pace with these fluctuations.

Our aim is to provide fair and equitable wages that aligns with the actual cost of living in the regions where we operate.

Conduct regional cost of living assessments to determine appropriate wage adjustments for different locations.

Develop transparent criteria based on inflation rates, cost of living indices, and industry benchmarks.

This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

This policy will be reviewed every year to track the progress on every issue and its targets.

Fair Compensation: Wage Disparities: Conduct regular salary audits to identify and rectify any unjustified wage disparities.
Inadequate Adjustments for Cost of Living: Conduct regional cost of living assessments to determine appropriate wage adjustments for different locations.
Lack of Transparent Compensation Policies: Provide employees with access to information about salary structures, criteria for promotions, and any other factors influencing compensation.
Skill-Based Compensation: Implement skill-based pay structures that reward employees for acquiring and applying additional skills relevant to their roles.
Regular Adjustments: Inconsistent Review Timelines: Establish a fixed schedule for regular wage reviews and clearly communicate the review timeline to employees
Lack of Transparent Criteria: Develop transparent criteria based on inflation rates, cost of living indices, and industry benchmarks.
Delayed Implementation: Streamline the approval process for adjustments and communicate adjustments promptly to maintain trust and morale.
Employee Participation and Feedback: Limited Communication Channels: Implement multiple communication channels, such as suggestion boxes, regular meetings, surveys, and digital platforms.
Fear of Retaliation: Establish a culture of open communication and non-retaliation and clearly communicate policies protecting employees from retaliation for providing feedback.
Inadequate Training and Awareness: Promote awareness of the importance of feedback in decision-making and improvement.
Geographic Considerations: Regional Wage Disparities: Adjust wages based on regional variations to ensure fair compensation across different locations.
Inconsistent Application of Benefits: Establish a standardized framework for providing additional benefits or allowances in regions with higher living costs.
Compliance with Legal Standards: Legal Repercussions: Regularly conduct legal reviews to ensure the living wage policy aligns with local, national, and international labor laws. Address any discrepancies promptly to avoid legal repercussions..
Employee Discontent and Turnover: Implement a transparent communication strategy to inform employees about the company's commitment to legal compliance.

targets.target: Achieve a 5% or lower wage disparity across job roles within the company by conducting quarterly salary audits
Conduct semi-annual surveys to gauge employee understanding of compensation policies, aiming for a 90% or higher satisfaction rate in terms of clarity
Ensure 100% payment of Living wage before the given deadline
Track the percentage of employees receiving skill-based bonuses or pay increases, aiming for a 10% increase
Monitor the timeliness of wage reviews quarterly, aiming for 100% compliance with the predetermined schedule
Attain a 95% or higher understanding among employees regarding the transparent criteria used for wage adjustments.
Ensure that 90% of approved adjustments are communicated to employees within two weeks of approval by constantly tracking the timings of adjustments.
Increase the number of communication channels by 20%
Conduct semi-annual employee surveys, focusing on their perception of open communication and non-retaliation, aiming for a satisfaction rate of 95% or above
Increase employee awareness of feedback importance by 15%
Achieve a regional wage variance of no more than 5% between any two locations
Ensure that 90% of employees in high-cost regions receive standardized additional benefits
Conduct bi-annual legal reviews and document any identified discrepancies. Aim for 100% resolution of identified issues
Reduce turnover rates by 15% through enhanced communication on legal compliance

responsibilities.duty: Approve the living-wage commitment and review progress against wage and benefit objectives.
Maintain wage benchmarks, implement equitable compensation, and administer wage-related grievance handling.
Ensure accurate, timely, traceable payment and maintain records for compensation and statutory benefits.
Communicate compensation practices clearly and escalate concerns affecting employee welfare.
Use available channels to raise wage or benefit concerns without fear of retaliation.

policy.monitoring:
In line with our commitment to transparency and accountability, Exim Knits Pvt Ltd has placed significant emphasis on reporting within the framework of our Living Wage Policy. Regular and comprehensive reporting has become a cornerstone of our commitment to fair compensation and ethical business practices. We understand the importance of keeping our stakeholders informed about our progress, challenges, and the impact of our living wage initiatives.

Our reports provide detailed insights into various aspects of our Living Wage Policy, including:

Updates on wage adjustments

Regional disparities in compensation

The outcomes of periodic cost of living assessments.

By sharing this information, we aim to foster trust among our employees, investors, and the wider community. Additionally, a detailed report is systematically prepared which highlights the steps taken to address any identified issues, ensuring that our commitment to legal compliance and fair compensation is backed by concrete actions.

Within the framework of our Living Wage Policy, continuous improvement stands as a guiding principle. We are committed to an ongoing process of refinement, closely monitoring the effectiveness of our compensation structures, employee feedback mechanisms, and regional adjustments. Through regular assessments and responsive adjustments, we aim to not only meet but exceed the evolving needs and expectations of our workforce. By fostering a culture of continuous improvement, we aspire to set new standards for fair and ethical compensation practices in the textile company, ensuring the sustained well-being of our employees and the communities we serve.
